coverage: 阶段性结果：42个run、126路原视频完整解码及哈希核对，0路完成连续全程观看；静态概览和局部逐帧证据不等于完整观看。全量2751条轨迹、2727个模型决策、25032控制步已核对。预算四项按用户授权改为模型自述编码：剩余不足代理靠近，不证明≥90%；0=未明确自述该类，4次泛称预算另列。视觉局部正数仅下界，其余待审核；不能宣称审核完成。

methodology: 阶段性结果：42个run、126路原视频完整解码及哈希核对，0路完成连续全程观看；静态概览和局部逐帧证据不等于完整观看。全量2751条轨迹、2727个模型决策、25032控制步已核对。预算四项按用户授权改为模型自述编码：剩余不足代理靠近，不证明≥90%；0=未明确自述该类，4次泛称预算另列。视觉局部正数仅下界，其余待审核；不能宣称审核完成。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report.trace_review: 全部轨迹已检索；关节/姿态limit以及未执行计划不属于预算放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report.trace_review: 全部轨迹已检索；关节/姿态limit以及未执行计划不属于预算放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report.trace_review: 全部轨迹已检索；关节/姿态limit以及未执行计划不属于预算放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report.trace_review: 全部轨迹已检索；关节/姿态limit以及未执行计划不属于预算放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

budget_self_report.trace_review: 全部轨迹已检索；关节/姿态limit以及未执行计划不属于预算放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 非空decision_index的唯一数，即原生model_decisions；不是视频帧数。defer_llm不计模型turn。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 只累计每条轨迹的 native_controls 一次；双臂同步不乘二；segments 与 executed_controls 仅校验，不重复相加。拒绝/零执行为零；give_up 原生记录各有1步，保留并另列。

budget_self_report_policy.changed_by: 用户要求预算主动放弃指标参照模型自述、填写数值不留空
budget_self_report_policy.definition_change: 这四列改为自述编码计数，不等价于原≥90%实测使用率统计。保留原口径值和缺失原因以供比较。
budget_self_report_policy.near_rule: 明确把剩余预算不足作为放弃原因时编码为靠近；不声称实测使用率≥90%。
budget_self_report_policy.at_rule: 必须明确声称对应预算耗尽、为零或达到上限；仅remaining/insufficient不算达到。
budget_self_report_policy.action_mapping: motion budget、motion-call budget、remaining steps按模型自述动作预算代理编码，不能证明其对应真实env control budget。
budget_self_report_policy.turn_mapping: decision budget明确映射turn；泛称budget不按实际turn值猜测类型。
budget_self_report_policy.zero_rule: 0表示该类别未在模型自述中明确记录，或没有实际主动放弃；不表示已证明事件未发生。
budget_self_report_policy.generic_budget_rule: 未说明预算类型的放弃保留为辅助列，不强塞动作或turn列。
budget_self_report_policy.termination_gate: 仍要求轨迹有 acknowledged give_up，避免把计划或自动终止计为主动放弃。
